metadata.description: Two Claude Code plugins: p4-phi, which keeps what linked sessions hand each other; and p4-temportal, which keeps the project's auto memory in its store by Claude Code's own autoMemoryDirectory, leaves each session's scratchpad to the app, and gives the store's files lifetimes.

plugins.name: p4-temportal
plugins.description: Keeps the project's auto memory, notebook and saved code in its .claude/p4 store, where Claude Code writes the memory itself by autoMemoryDirectory, leaves each session's scratchpad to the app, clears what is no longer relevant by lifetimes, and keeps a compaction from losing what a session needs.

plugins.name: p4-phi
plugins.description: What linked Claude Code sessions hand each other.
